faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.prompt: Need help planning your screen or AV hire? Speak to our team for practical advice and a tailored quote.

items.question: What LED screen hire services do you offer in London?
items.answer: We provide indoor and outdoor LED screen hire, TV hire, projector hire, video wall hire, digital signage, and complete AV equipment rental for corporate events, exhibitions, conferences, weddings, and live events across London.

items.question: Do you provide setup and technical support?
items.answer: Yes. Our experienced team handles delivery, installation, testing, on-site technical support, and dismantling to ensure your event runs smoothly.

items.question: Can I hire LED screens for a one-day event?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer flexible rental options for one-day events, weekends, and long-term hire based on your requirements.

items.question: What size LED screens do you offer?
items.answer: We offer a wide range of LED screen sizes suitable for indoor and outdoor events, from small presentations to large-scale concerts and exhibitions.

items.question: How much does LED screen hire cost in London?
items.answer: Pricing depends on screen size, rental duration, event location, and technical requirements. Contact us for a free, no-obligation quote tailored to your event.
